newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs end flat, spread over Bunds seen wider.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs end flat, spread over Bunds seen wider.

text.p: Belgian bonds lagged German Bunds slightly in their rise on Tuesday, weighed down by an OLO exchange auction and with the prospect of further spread widening ahead of Monday's monthly OLO auction.
Otherwise, favourable comments on European monetary union made at a FrancO-German summit in Kempten, Germany, gave the market some support, dealers said.

"There was optimism after (Bundesbank President) Tietmeyer said the yield curve could flatten," said one dealer. But he added that this had been countered by growing fears of an imminent rise in the U.S. Federal Reserve's fed funds rate.
